name: KMS '*' is NOT anonymous (the sharpest trap)
note: acceptance-suite-4 test 109. A Principal {AWS:'*'} KMS key policy is NOT anonymous/public: KMS has no unauthenticated request path, so '*' represents every AWS identity in every account (cross-account still double-authorized). The generic PUBLIC-ACCESS finding is emitted with KMS-correct wording (the not-anonymous reframe is scoped to the kms-key token) - critical over-grant, no anonymous/unauthenticated/anyone-on-the-internet wording, and Resource:'*' = the attached key only (no per-key node explosion). resource.anonymous is cleared for KMS so metadata does not contradict the text.

PUBLIC-ACCESS: every AWS identity in every account
